description: Ask what one piece of gated content costs right now, read directly from the chain. Takes the creator vault id and the content key, NOT a post id, which cannot be resolved on this deployment. Returns the price as a decimal string in the smallest on-chain unit. Reads only; it never spends. A price you read here is information, not permission: your ceiling comes from your principal.

contentKey.description: The vault-scoped content key the post is sold under. Not a post id and not a URL.

vaultId.description: The creator vault's object id, 0x-prefixed, as returned by a directory or a profile.
